sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/12] Parents of all 8-grade girls and boys from the participating schools were sent a description of the study along with an informed consent letter, and active parental consent and adolescent assent were obtained from all participants. This resulted in an average participation rate of 53% of eligible students across schools, similar to that observed in other school-recruited samples using active consent procedures and structured interviews (e.g., 61% for Lewinsohn et al., 1994).

lag.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/13] Participants completed a self-report questionnaire, participated in a structured psychiatric interview, and had their weight and height measured by research assistants at baseline (T1) and at 1- and 2-year follow-up (T2 and T3, respectively).
